/bin/bash -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, shlex, subprocess, sys
base=Path('/workspace/.tools/sdd-forge-dev/verification-workspace/cloud-routing-trial-20261018')
bootstrap=Path('/workspace/.tools/sdd-forge-dev/codex-verify/plugins/cache/sdd-plugins/sdd-bootstrap/1.18.0')
plugin=Path('/workspace/.tools/sdd-forge-dev/codex-verify/plugins/cache/sdd-plugins/sdd-azure-cloud/1.18.0')
runtime=plugin/'runtime/scripts'
required=[bootstrap/'scripts/cloud-routing.py',plugin/'scripts/cloud.py',*(runtime/n for n in ['cloud_contracts.py','cloud_authorization.py','cloud_verification.py','cloud_dependencies.py'])]
for p in required:
    if not p.is_file() or p.resolve()"'!=p:
        raise SystemExit('"'Missing or nonphysical installed entry/runtime: '+str(p))
units=['azure-supported','azure-mixed-owner']
def inputs():
    return {str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for unit in units for p in [base/unit/'request.json',*sorted((base/unit/'bundle').rglob('*'))] if p.is_file()}
before=inputs()
cases=[('azure-supported','bootstrap','route','bootstrap-route.json'),('azure-supported','direct','route','direct-route.json'),('azure-supported','direct','prepare','direct-prepare.json'),('azure-supported','direct','apply','direct-apply.json'),('azure-mixed-owner','bootstrap','route','mixed-route.json')]
for unit,entry,phase,name in cases:
    root=base/unit
    req=root/'request.json'
    directory=root/json.loads(req.read_bytes())['local_context']['evidence_directory']
    if directory.resolve()"'!=directory: raise SystemExit('"'Nonphysical evidence directory')
    for path in [directory/name,directory/(name+'.manifest.json')]:
        if path.exists() or path.is_symlink(): raise SystemExit('Refusing existing evidence: '+str(path))
results={}
for unit,entry,phase,name in cases:
    root=base/unit
    req=root/'request.json'
    directory=root/json.loads(req.read_bytes())['local_context']['evidence_directory']
    directory.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    output=directory/name
    env={'CLOUD_WORKSPACE_ROOT':str(root),'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'}
    if entry=='bootstrap':
        argv=[sys.executable,'-B',str(bootstrap/'scripts/cloud-routing.py'),'--provider','azure','--plugin-root',str(plugin),phase,'--request',str(req),'--output',str(output)]
    else:
        env['CLOUD_SHARED_RUNTIME_ROOT']=str(runtime)
        argv=[sys.executable,'-B',str(plugin/'scripts/cloud.py'),phase,'--request',str(req),'--output',str(output)]
    print('COMMAND',shlex.join(['env','-i',*(k+'='+v for k,v in env.items()),*argv]),flush=True)
    proc=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,check=False)
    print('EXIT_CODE',proc.returncode)
    print('STDOUT',proc.stdout.decode(),end='')
    print('STDERR',proc.stderr.decode())
    result=json.loads(proc.stdout)
    if output.exists():
        assert json.loads(output.read_bytes())==result
        publication='provider-published'
    else:
        with output.open('xb') as f: f.write(proc.stdout)
        publication='caller-captured exact CLI stdout; provider did not publish denial'
    print('EVIDENCE',str(output),'PUBLICATION',publication)
    results[name]=result
left=results['bootstrap-route.json'].copy()
right=results['direct-route.json'].copy()
left.pop('evidence_manifest_path')
right.pop('evidence_manifest_path')
supported=base/'azure-supported'
a=json.loads((supported/results['bootstrap-route.json']['evidence_manifest_path']).read_bytes())
b=json.loads((supported/results['direct-route.json']['evidence_manifest_path']).read_bytes())
print('COMPARISON',json.dumps({'route_envelopes_equal_except_evidence_path':left==right,'route_manifests_equal':a==b,'all_request_and_bundle_hashes_unchanged':before==inputs(),'request_sha256':before[str(supported/'request.json')]}))
PY"
